name: Anchovy fish sauce
summary: In the rains, when Sê San anchovy will not dry, the landing ferments it into fish sauce. The 22 July 2022 article quotes 80,000 VND a litre from one resident.
origin: Nguyễn Văn Triều, a Sê San fishing-village resident quoted by the Vietnam National Authority of Tourism on 22 July 2022.
howToEat: Ferment the anchovy when the rain stops the drying. The article calls the result a straight anchovy sauce.
where: The Sê San landing. A shop address is Check on arrival.
priceBand: The 22 July 2022 article quotes 80,000 VND a litre. A current price is Check on arrival.
